description: Implementation of a service class for initializing database references and entities in a sales management system, including creation of languages, countries, zones, currencies, merchant store, modules, and product types.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing database initialization logic for reference data and merchant setup.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate database with languages, countries, zones, currencies, sub-references, modules, and merchant data.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entries based on predefined currency codes.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries with localized descriptions.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Loads and creates zone entries with descriptions from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined language codes.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Creates a default merchant store with associated tax class.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Loads and creates integration modules from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database is empty based on language count.
